name: Party Type 16 Code
definition: Identifies the entity which initially sets the authorisation response value.

DLIS.name: Delegate Issuer
DLIS.definition: Party to whom the card issuer delegates to authorise card payment transactions.

ITAG.name: Intermediary Agent
ITAG.definition: Party acting on behalf of other parties to process or forward data to other parties.

OTRM.name: Originating Terminal
OTRM.definition: Application on the terminal which has initiated the transaction.

BKAF.name: Account From Bank
BKAF.definition: The bank of the source account.

BKAT.name: Account To Bank
BKAT.definition: The bank of the destination account.
